beats.say: Tetris has sold over 520 million copies across its many platforms.
At number five, Mario Kart 8 and its Deluxe version reached 79.99 million sales.
Wii Sports takes the fourth spot with 82.9 million copies sold on the Wii.
Red Dead Redemption 2 sits at number three, achieving 87 million sales.
Grand Theft Auto 5 holds second place with a massive 230 million copies sold.
But the champion is Tetris, with more than double the sales of its nearest rival. Level Up covers gaming history, subscribe to keep your knowledge at the max.
